details.publicNotes:
Eternal inventors arise when a genius inventor takes a mortal wound from an ambitious experiment and spends their final moments frantically recording observations in their journal. Their spirit becomes trapped in the journal, where it is doomed to relive its failure.

Though the journal is a physical object, it is surrounded by the spectral form of the inventor. The inventor incessantly carries out their final experiment, confident that they'll soon succeed. However, their efforts are doomed to fail, and they pay no heed to the death and destruction that their obsession creates. The only way for an eternal inventor's spirit to rest is for someone to complete their final project. This task is incredibly difficult, not only because the eternal inventor's dreams push the boundaries of the possible but also because they tend to jealously slay anyone they suspect of attempting to steal their glory.

An eternal inventor is often surrounded by numerous hazards and inventions, and the line between the two is surprisingly difficult to discern.

They Called It Impossible!

For some reason, inventors seem drawn to experiments involving lightning or explosions, so their deaths usually involve fiery or electrical mishaps. That said, some eternal inventors found more creative ways to die and wish to share that experience with those who stumble upon their final resting places. Some of these experiments include attempts to harness antigravity (causing the inventor to fall up into an improbably sturdy ceiling fan), a method for fast healing involving the acceleration of local time (causing flesh to crumble into dust and blow away), and the preservation of food using cold (predictably causing the inventor to be frozen within a block of ice).

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 1,875/4,300/8,000 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning, piercing, slashing), armor (light), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Crafting, Occultism)

Eligible Imbued Properties burning barbs, death, dexterity, electricity, energy resistant (void), fire, fire shield, ice, intelligence, mind, mind shield, mirrored, music, sensory (darkvision), space, space shield, spells (Occult: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.qlxM7Ik3uUeUIOcv]{Canticle of Everlasting Grief}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.73rToy0v5Ra9NvL6]{Duplicate Foe}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.eIQ86FOXK34HiNLs]{Embed Message}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.jrBa9deU2ULFWvSl]{Falling Stars}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.MJx7DmjsWYzDZ3a4]{Phantasmagoria}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul}, @UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-spells.ty07K2w88LGu9FC7]{Telekinetic Storm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spells.O7ZEqWjwdKyo2CUv]{Volcanic Eruption}), spirit, throwing, unholy, wild, winged

description.value:
You create a temporary duplicate of an enemy to fight on your behalf. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to disrupt the spell. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and has the target's attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 70 Hit Points and lacks the target's special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except weapon potency runes.

The duplicate gains the minion trait, and it can only Stride and Strike. Its Strikes deal the target's normal damage but don't apply added effects, since it doesn't have special abilities. The spell automatically ends if the duplicate's Hit Points drop to 0.

The duplicate attacks your enemies to the best of its abilities. You can also try to give it additional instructions; when you Sustain the spell, you can also Command a Minion as part of your action, but the GM determines whether the duplicate follows your command.

The duplicate is unstable, so each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 4d6 Hit Points. It's not a living creature, and it can never regain its lost Hit Points in any way.

Critical Success You fail to create a duplicate.

Success The duplicate deals half damage with its Strikes and the duration is reduced to a maximum of 2 rounds.

Failure The duplicate works as described.

Heightened (+1) The level of creature you can target increases by 2. The duplicate has 10 more HP.

Area 4 40-foot bursts

You reach into the skies and call down an array of falling stars that explode upon colliding with the ground. Choose for the falling stars to be airbursts (sonic), asteroids (fire), comets (cold), or plasma (electricity). The spell gains the trait of the falling star type you chose. The four stars' central 10-foot bursts can't overlap. Each falling star deals 6d10 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the @Template[burst|distance:10] at the center of its area of effect before exploding, dealing 14d6 energy damage of the type you chose to each creature in its @Template[burst|distance:40]. A creature in any of the areas attempts one basic Reflex save against the spell no matter how many overlapping explosions it's caught in and can take each type of damage only once.

Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10, and the energy damage increases by 2d6.

You fill the targets' minds with endless images, like countless dreams and lives colliding with each other. The onrushing information deals @Damage[16d6[mental]] damage to each target, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is confused for 1 minute.

You create a melody distilled from pure grief, conveying the inevitable loss of everything your target cherishes, audible to only them. The target takes 10d6 mental damage depending on its Will save. A creature cursed by this spell can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses, for the duration noted in the degree of success.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage, is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and is cursed for 1 round.

Failure The target takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and is cursed for 1 week.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}, and is cursed for an unlimited duration. While the curse remains, the target's allies are also affected by the curse while within 15 feet of the creature.

You transport the target into an extraplanar puzzle room of mysterious origin, locking them there. Once each turn as a single action, the target can attempt an Occultism check, Perception check, or Thievery check against your spell DC to solve the puzzle. Teleportation effects can't carry the target outside the puzzle room unless they can also traverse the planes, such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}. When the spell ends, the target returns to the space it occupied when it was banished, or to the nearest space if the original is now filled.

Critical Success The target solves the puzzle and escapes.

Success The target is on the right path to the solution. If it was already on the right path, it solves the puzzle and escapes.

Failure The target makes no progress toward a solution.

Critical Failure The target makes no progress and, if it was on the right path, it no longer is.

Area 5-foot radius, 80-foot-tall cylinder

The ground opens up, spraying a column of lava high into the air in a vertical cylinder, dealing 14d6 fire damage to creatures in the area. The lava rapidly cools and encases creatures in the area. A creature encased in rock is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds. All normal terrain is difficult terrain to a flying creature, and such creatures immediately descend 20 feet the moment they're encased, but they don't take damage from this fall. A creature encased in rock can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to end the effect. Otherwise, the creature remains encased until it takes a total of 50 damage, freeing it from the rock. Additionally, creatures in the area and those within 5 feet of the lava column automatically take @Damage[(@item.rank -4)d6[fire]] damage from the intense heat, regardless of the results of their saving throws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.8UqFvOCZqecPam4Y]{Spell Effect: Volcanic Eruption}

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is encased.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is encased.

Heightened (+1) The damage in the area increases by 2d6, and the damage from the intense heat increases by 1d6.

A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.

target.value: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

description.value:
You gather a storm of unattended objects in the area of 10 Bulk or less, crushing large and easily breakable objects like furniture into splinters and using the pieces to barrage your foes. All creatures and unattended objects in the area take 4d10 bludgeoning damage, 4d10 piercing damage, and 4d10 slashing damage.

Heightened (9th) The bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage each increase by 1d10.

You specify a trigger and a message up to 25 words long. When the specified trigger occurs within 30 feet of the target, illusory text of your message circles the target accompanied by a disembodied voice. You can choose a language you know for the text and speech, and can choose what the voice sounds like. Once the message is completed, the spell ends.

Heightened (4th) You can add a simple sensory component to emphasize the message, such as an odor, visual effect, or physical sensation. This addition is obviously illusory and part of the message, lasting only while the message is being read.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, but you can choose how many times the spell repeats the message before it ends; there is no limit to the number of repetitions.

You move the target up to 20 feet, potentially suspending it in midair. When you Sustain the Spell, you can do so again, or you can shift your telekinetic focus to a different eligible target within range, moving it instead.

target.value: 1 unattended object of up to 80 Bulk with no dimension longer than 20 feet

description.value: The eternal inventor communicates by replaying past scenes of their speech during life. They can't say any words that they didn't say at least once while alive.

When an eternal inventor is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} in its creator's office or workshop, fully healed. An eternal inventor can only be permanently destroyed if the project that took the creator's life is successfully completed.

Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the eternal inventor performs an action with the manipulate trait

Effect The eternal inventor curses the object the creature is manipulating or the manipulating creature. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:38] save. On a failure, the action is disrupted and the creature injures itself, taking @Damage[13[untyped]] damage of an appropriate type for the item or action's nature.

The eternal inventor manifests a floating cannon in their square and fires it in their choice of two @Template[type:cone|distance:30]s or two @Template[type:line|distance:60]s that point in opposite directions. The cannon deals 4d8 physical damage and 4d4 energy damage (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save). For each direction, they choose between bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing for the physical damage and between cold, electricity, fire, or sonic for the energy damage.

@Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[4d6[piercing]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[4d6[slashing]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[4d6[cold]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[4d6[electricity]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage]

@Damage[4d6[sonic]|options:area-damage]
When a creature resists or is weak to damage dealt by the eternal inventor, they automatically determine the resistance or weakness's type and amount.

The eternal inventor replicates the accident that claimed their life, such the in-flight detonation of an alchemical jetpack attempting to break the sound barrier or the unstoppable rampage of a nigh-invincible construct that turned against its creator. Each creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] around the eternal inventor takes @Damage[16d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage of a type appropriate to the accident's nature, such as bludgeoning or fire (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save). Creatures that fail the saving throw are also flooded with the creator's dying despair, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure. The eternal inventor can't use Relive Catastrophe for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
